cars.variant: 3.0-litre eight-speed automatic — May 2019 European launch reference
cars.specification_market: 2019 European launch GR Supra 3.0-litre six-cylinder, eight-speed automatic, as specified in Toyota Motor Europe’s May 2019 press kit. Count the fifth-generation A90 road programme once across later A91-edition names, 2.0-litre/3.0-litre engines, power revisions and manual/automatic choices. Not the older A60/A70/A80 Supras, FT-1 concept, GT4 racer or Final Edition specification. BMW-derived platform/running gear are acknowledged; the already-listed G29 Z4 roadster remains a separate named road-car programme, not an A90 alias. Origin country reflects Toyota’s Japanese programme identity; the factory states manufacture in Graz, Austria. Independent 2020 US award context is not a transfer of US specifications or test numbers to this European launch reference.
cars.summary: The fifth-generation GR Supra revived a major Japanese sports-car name as the first global GR road model. Car and Driver’s original 2020 10Best assessment supports its responsive handling and driver communication while acknowledging restricted visibility and divisive styling. This modern two-seat coupe represents the A90 road generation once across engine outputs, transmissions, editions and years.

sources.title: 2020 Toyota Supra: Car and Driver’s 10Best — Rich Ceppos, 21 November 2019
sources.notes: Relevant full award body and specification panel read. Supports programme-level driver appeal, acknowledges BMW-derived running gear and visibility/styling drawbacks. No US test time, lap time, mass, SAE output, price or economy imported into European reference. Award year 2020 and publication 2019 do not define separate generations.
